evidence.title: Corporate - MGM Property Management
evidence.text:
In 2007 Mr. Morse founded MGM Property Management, L.L.C. to provide management services for apartment communities owned by entities affiliated with MGM.

Kevin Morse has been in Real Estate for almost 30 years. In 1989 he graduated from Arizona State University with a BS in Real Estate. Mr. Morse began his Real Estate career in Phoenix, Arizona as a Real Estate Broker providing leasing, sales, and management services for industrial properties.

In 1997 Mr. Morse relocated to Chicago, Illinois and took a position as Director for an Apartment Community Property Management Company that owned communities in Illinois and Wisconsin.

Certified Apartment Manager (CAM) by the National Apartment Association. Assisted Housing Manager (AHM) requirements of HUD by Quadel Consulting. EIV Basics Certificate, EIV Discrepancies, Certificate EIV Interim, Certification EIV Annual Recertification. TRACS Voucher Submission Requirements Certification.

Tiffany Blakemore brings over 20 years of dynamic Property Management experience, leading teams across Conventional, LIHTC, and HUD Section 8 communities. With a strong background in operations, compliance, and training, Tiffany is known for elevating asset performance, strengthening teams, and driving consistent improvement in budget and NOI results.

MGM Property Management, L.L.C. is a full service property management company specializing in management of apartment communities in Indiana, Michigan, Illinois, Arkansas and Louisiana. Our goal is to provide our residents with an exceptional product at an affordable price.
